title: How AI Unleashed (Not Replaced) My Creativity | Kelly A. Boesch | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】人工智慧如何釋放（而非取代）我的創造力 |凱利·A·博施 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: As an artist, I want to tell you that AI has completely changed the trajectory of my life.
cues.en: As an artist, I want to tell you that AI has completely changed the trajectory of my life.
cues.zh: 身為藝術家，我想告訴大家，人工智慧徹底改變了我的人生軌跡。

cues.text: Let me show you into some of my worlds.
cues.en: Let me show you into some of my worlds.
cues.zh: 讓我帶你進入我的一些世界。

cues.text: When some people were focused on productivity and efficiency, I'd been focused on trying to figure out how to incorporate AI into my art.
cues.en: When some people were focused on productivity and efficiency, I'd been focused on trying to figure out how to incorporate AI into my art.
cues.zh: 當有些人專注於生產力和效率時，我一直專注於試圖弄清楚如何將人工智慧融入我的藝術中。

cues.text: Like a new paintbrush, a canvas, a camera, a music studio,
cues.en: Like a new paintbrush, a canvas, a camera, a music studio,
cues.zh: 就像一支新畫筆、一塊畫布、一臺相機、一個音樂工作室，

cues.text: a doorway into my imagination.
cues.en: a doorway into my imagination.
cues.zh: 進入我想像的一扇門。

cues.text: I’ve worked in film production, fashion and most recently as a graphic designer.
cues.en: I’ve worked in film production, fashion and most recently as a graphic designer.
cues.zh: 我曾從事電影製作、時尚工作，最近擔任平面設計師。

cues.text: But nothing has sparked my curiosity like AI has.
cues.en: But nothing has sparked my curiosity like AI has.
cues.zh: 但沒有什麼比人工智慧更能激發我的好奇心了。

cues.text: My first images were less “visionary artist” and more, as my friends used to say,
cues.en: My first images were less “visionary artist” and more, as my friends used to say,
cues.zh: 我的第一張照片不太像“有遠見的藝術家”，而是像我的朋友們常說的那樣，

cues.text: "What is that?" But I leaned into the strangeness of the AI,
cues.en: "What is that?" But I leaned into the strangeness of the AI,
cues.zh: 「那是什麼？」但我傾向於人工智慧的奇怪之處，

cues.text: and now it has become my signature style.
cues.en: and now it has become my signature style.
cues.zh: 現在它已經成為我的標誌性風格。

cues.text: And I feel like I have a new superpower, and I'm only limited by my imagination,
cues.en: And I feel like I have a new superpower, and I'm only limited by my imagination,
cues.zh: 我感覺我擁有了一種新的超能力，而我只受限於我的想像力，

cues.text: which seems to be endlessly fueled with ideas now.
cues.en: which seems to be endlessly fueled with ideas now.
cues.zh: 現在似乎充滿了無窮無盡的想法。

cues.text: For the first time, the distance between what I imagined
cues.en: For the first time, the distance between what I imagined
cues.zh: 第一次和想像中的差距

cues.text: and what I could create has closed.
cues.en: and what I could create has closed.
cues.zh: 我能創造的東西已經結束了。

cues.text: Once AI video was available, I started animating my AI images and making short films.
cues.en: Once AI video was available, I started animating my AI images and making short films.
cues.zh: 一旦人工智慧影片可用，我就開始製作人工智慧影象動畫並製作短片。

cues.text: But I felt like something was missing.
cues.en: But I felt like something was missing.
cues.zh: 但我感覺好像缺少了什麼。

cues.text: So I wanted to make my own music to better match the emotion behind my visuals.
cues.en: So I wanted to make my own music to better match the emotion behind my visuals.
cues.zh: 所以我想製作自己的音樂來更好地匹配我的視覺效果背後的情感。

cues.text: So I started writing lyrics and using AI to collaborate on the instrumentation.
cues.en: So I started writing lyrics and using AI to collaborate on the instrumentation.
cues.zh: 所以我開始寫歌詞並使用人工智慧來協作演奏樂器。

cues.text: And I draw my inspiration for my lyrics from my visuals
cues.en: And I draw my inspiration for my lyrics from my visuals
cues.zh: 我從視覺效果中汲取歌詞靈感

cues.text: or from my life experiences.
cues.en: or from my life experiences.
cues.zh: 或來自我的生活經驗。

cues.text: And I never thought that my music would take on a life of its own.
cues.en: And I never thought that my music would take on a life of its own.
cues.zh: 我從未想過我的音樂會擁有自己的生命。

cues.text: But it has, as I just landed a record deal.
cues.en: But it has, as I just landed a record deal.
cues.zh: 但它已經發生了，因為我剛剛達成了唱片合約。

cues.text: Thank you. That feels extraordinary at this chapter of my life.
cues.en: Thank you. That feels extraordinary at this chapter of my life.
cues.zh: 謝謝。在我人生的這一章，這種感覺非比尋常。

cues.text: When the music and the visual align perfectly, it can feel like magic.
cues.en: When the music and the visual align perfectly, it can feel like magic.
cues.zh: 當音樂和視覺完美結合時，感覺就像魔法一樣。

cues.text: In this next clip I'm going to show you, from my video "Quiet Rebellion",
cues.en: In this next clip I'm going to show you, from my video "Quiet Rebellion",
cues.zh: 在下一個剪輯中，我將向您展示我的影片「安靜的叛亂」中，

cues.text: I wrote these lyrics about living as your authentic self
cues.en: I wrote these lyrics about living as your authentic self
cues.zh: 我寫了這些關於活出真實自我的歌詞

cues.text: and wearing your strange like a crown.
cues.en: and wearing your strange like a crown.
cues.zh: 並像戴著王冠一樣戴著你的怪異。

cues.text: Let the rhythm be wide and the logic be thin.
cues.en: Let the rhythm be wide and the logic be thin.
cues.zh: 讓節奏寬一點，邏輯細一點。

cues.text: I'm living in the spaces where the secrets begin.
cues.en: I'm living in the spaces where the secrets begin.
cues.zh: 我活在秘密開始的空間。

cues.text: It's a quiet rebellion, a soft kind of war.
cues.en: It's a quiet rebellion, a soft kind of war.
cues.zh: 這是一場安靜的叛亂，一場溫和的戰爭。

cues.text: There'll be somethin' the world hasn't tasted before.
cues.en: There'll be somethin' the world hasn't tasted before.
cues.zh: 將會有一些世界上從未嚐過的東西。

cues.text: There is a fire in the fold, a grace in the strange.
cues.en: There is a fire in the fold, a grace in the strange.
cues.zh: 褶皺中有火焰，奇異中有恩典。

cues.text: I am ink on the page that refuses to change.
cues.en: I am ink on the page that refuses to change.
cues.zh: 我是拒絕改變的頁面上的墨水。

cues.text: Thank you. Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you. Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。謝謝。

cues.text: Lately, people have been asking me these same two questions: Is it really art and how do you do it?
cues.en: Lately, people have been asking me these same two questions: Is it really art and how do you do it?
cues.zh: 最近，人們一直在問我同樣的兩個問題：這真的是藝術嗎？你是如何做到的？

cues.text: And this first one's really hard for me to answer, because AI art is brand new,
cues.en: And this first one's really hard for me to answer, because AI art is brand new,
cues.zh: 第一個問題對我來說真的很難回答，因為人工智慧藝術是全新的，

cues.text: and we're all still trying to figure out where it fits in.
cues.en: and we're all still trying to figure out where it fits in.
cues.zh: 我們仍在努力找出它適合的位置。

cues.text: And there intense feelings on both sides, and lots of discussion about AI being trained on other artists’ work --
cues.en: And there intense feelings on both sides, and lots of discussion about AI being trained on other artists’ work --
cues.zh: 雙方都有強烈的感情，並且有很多關於人工智慧在其他藝術家的作品上進行訓練的討論——

cues.text: as I was as an art major.
cues.en: as I was as an art major.
cues.zh: 就像我作為一個藝術專業的學生一樣。

cues.text: But when I sit down to create, there's no other artists' work on my screen.
cues.en: But when I sit down to create, there's no other artists' work on my screen.
cues.zh: 但當我坐下來創作時，我的螢幕上沒有其他藝術家的作品。

cues.text: I use references from things in nature, like flowers or insects,
cues.en: I use references from things in nature, like flowers or insects,
cues.zh: 我引用自然界中的事物，例如花朵或昆蟲，

cues.text: patterns, fashion, or whimsical ideas that have been floating around in my head.
cues.en: patterns, fashion, or whimsical ideas that have been floating around in my head.
cues.zh: 圖案、時尚或異想天開的想法一直在我腦海中浮現。

cues.text: For me, art is personal.
cues.en: For me, art is personal.
cues.zh: 對我來說，藝術是個人的。

cues.text: I just want to make things that bring me joy.
cues.en: I just want to make things that bring me joy.
cues.zh: 我只想做一些能帶給我快樂的事。

cues.text: And if they do the same to someone else, well, maybe that's the definition right there.
cues.en: And if they do the same to someone else, well, maybe that's the definition right there.
cues.zh: 如果他們對其他人做同樣的事情，那麼，也許這就是定義。

cues.text: And how do you do it?
cues.en: And how do you do it?
cues.zh: 你是如何做到的？

cues.text: Let me take you behind the scenes for a moment.
cues.en: Let me take you behind the scenes for a moment.
cues.zh: 讓我帶您瞭解幕後花絮。

cues.text: This image was made in Midjourney using this prompt, "A character in a fairy tale scene in a marketplace,
cues.en: This image was made in Midjourney using this prompt, "A character in a fairy tale scene in a marketplace,
cues.zh: 該影象是在中途使用以下提示製作的：「市場中童話場景中的角色，

cues.text: enchanted and cinematic." And it's an OK image. Very AI, nothing at all special.
cues.en: enchanted and cinematic." And it's an OK image. Very AI, nothing at all special.
cues.zh: 令人著迷且電影化。 ”這是一個不錯的影象。非常AI，沒什麼特別的。

cues.text: Now here's that exact same prompt using my personalization code
cues.en: Now here's that exact same prompt using my personalization code
cues.zh: 現在，這是使用我的個人化程式碼的完全相同的提示

cues.text: and the style reference code.
cues.en: and the style reference code.
cues.zh: 以及樣式參考程式碼。

cues.text: And I've worked really hard to get my images to look like this.
cues.en: And I've worked really hard to get my images to look like this.
cues.zh: 我非常努力地讓我的影象看起來像這樣。

cues.text: A lot of trial and error and time spent training the AI on my personal style and aesthetic.
cues.en: A lot of trial and error and time spent training the AI on my personal style and aesthetic.
cues.zh: 大量的嘗試和錯誤以及花費了時間來根據我的個人風格和美學來訓練人工智慧。

cues.text: Now, here's a short clip of the final video.
cues.en: Now, here's a short clip of the final video.
cues.zh: 現在，這是最終影片的短片。

cues.text: Welcome to the marketplace where nothing's ever priced the same.
cues.en: Welcome to the marketplace where nothing's ever priced the same.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到市場，這裡沒有任何東西的價格是相同的。

cues.text: You trade your time, you trade your name, you have to laugh.
cues.en: You trade your time, you trade your name, you have to laugh.
cues.zh: 你交換你的時間，你交換你的名字，你必須笑。

cues.text: The stalls are built from maybe-so, the cards all say "you'll know, you'll know".
cues.en: The stalls are built from maybe-so, the cards all say "you'll know, you'll know".
cues.zh: 這些攤位都是根據「也許」建造的，卡片上都寫著「你會知道的，你會知道的」。

cues.text: You buy a dream, it's buy-one-hope and something extra.
cues.en: You buy a dream, it's buy-one-hope and something extra.
cues.zh: 你買了一個夢想，它買的是一個希望和一些額外的東西。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: When AI is guided by human feeling, empathy and intention,
cues.en: When AI is guided by human feeling, empathy and intention,
cues.zh: 當人工智慧以人類的情感、同理心和意圖為指導時，

cues.text: it could become something else entirely.
cues.en: it could become something else entirely.
cues.zh: 它可能會完全變成另外一種東西。

cues.text: You can't explain creativity.
cues.en: You can't explain creativity.
cues.zh: 你無法解釋創造力。

cues.text: You just follow it.
cues.en: You just follow it.
cues.zh: 你只要跟著它。

cues.text: But this is what I do know.
cues.en: But this is what I do know.
cues.zh: 但這是我所知道的。

cues.text: I started making the best work of my life since I started using AI as a cocreator,
cues.en: I started making the best work of my life since I started using AI as a cocreator,
cues.zh: 自從我開始使用人工智慧作為共同創造者以來，我開始創作我一生中最好的作品，

cues.text: and my life has taken off like a rocket ship.
cues.en: and my life has taken off like a rocket ship.
cues.zh: 我的生活就像火箭飛船一樣起飛了。

cues.text: Millions of people have found their way to my work through my social sites and music apps.
cues.en: Millions of people have found their way to my work through my social sites and music apps.
cues.zh: 數百萬人透過我的社交網站和音樂應用程式找到了我的作品。

cues.text: And I feel different, I feel lighter, I feel curious again,
cues.en: And I feel different, I feel lighter, I feel curious again,
cues.zh: 我感覺不同了，我感覺更輕鬆，我再次感到好奇，

cues.text: and I love using this technology to tell stories that are close to my heart.
cues.en: and I love using this technology to tell stories that are close to my heart.
cues.zh: 我喜歡用這項技術來講述我內心深處的故事。

cues.text: This next clip is a tribute to older generations and not losing your sense of wonder.
cues.en: This next clip is a tribute to older generations and not losing your sense of wonder.
cues.zh: 下一個影片是對老一輩的致敬，同時也不失您的好奇心。

cues.text: The restless chase has drifted by, no longer racing for the prize.
cues.en: The restless chase has drifted by, no longer racing for the prize.
cues.zh: 焦灼的追逐已經過去，不再爭奪獎品。

cues.text: Now we savor morning's sigh and see new wonder in old eyes.
cues.en: Now we savor morning's sigh and see new wonder in old eyes.
cues.zh: 現在，我們品味著早晨的嘆息，在舊眼中看到新的奇蹟。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: I feel like we're standing at the beginning of a renaissance, and the possibilities are endless.
cues.en: I feel like we're standing at the beginning of a renaissance, and the possibilities are endless.
cues.zh: 我覺得我們正站在文藝復興的開端，可能性是無限的。

cues.text: We haven't even tapped into all of the ways to use AI creatively.
cues.en: We haven't even tapped into all of the ways to use AI creatively.
cues.zh: 我們甚至還沒有充分利用創造性地使用人工智慧的所有方法。

cues.text: And people who have never felt creative a day in their life
cues.en: And people who have never felt creative a day in their life
cues.zh: 以及那些一生中從未感受到創意的人

cues.text: are trying AI and sparking that creativity for the first time.
cues.en: are trying AI and sparking that creativity for the first time.
cues.zh: 正在嘗試人工智慧並首次激發創造力。

cues.text: And that's incredible.
cues.en: And that's incredible.
cues.zh: 這太不可思議了。

cues.text: So my takeaway for today is if you are curious about AI,
cues.en: So my takeaway for today is if you are curious about AI,
cues.zh: 所以我今天的要點是如果你對人工智慧感到好奇，

cues.text: try to play a little and make something beautiful or make something strange,
cues.en: try to play a little and make something beautiful or make something strange,
cues.zh: 試著玩一點，創造一些美麗的東西或創造一些奇怪的東西，

cues.text: but let yourself be surprised by what comes out.
cues.en: but let yourself be surprised by what comes out.
cues.zh: 但讓自己對結果感到驚訝。

cues.text: But most of all, find your joy.
cues.en: But most of all, find your joy.
cues.zh: 但最重要的是，找到你的快樂。

cues.text: I never found a reason why I had to learn to dance.
cues.en: I never found a reason why I had to learn to dance.
cues.zh: 我從來沒有找到我必須學習跳舞的理由。

cues.text: My feet and music found each other.
cues.en: My feet and music found each other.
cues.zh: 我的雙腳和音樂找到了彼此。

cues.text: We knew it at first glance.
cues.en: We knew it at first glance.
cues.zh: 我們一看就知道了。

cues.text: From the moment I could walk my feet just up and ran.
cues.en: From the moment I could walk my feet just up and ran.
cues.zh: 從那一刻起，我就可以站起來跑步了。

cues.text: When I hear a song, I see a floor, my feet just understand.
cues.en: When I hear a song, I see a floor, my feet just understand.
cues.zh: 當我聽到一首歌時，我看到了地板，我的腳就明白了。

cues.text: Thank you so much. Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you so much. Thank you.
cues.zh: 太感謝了。謝謝。
